title: API Activity event (cloud control-plane and SaaS API telemetry for identity-compromise lateral hunt)
summary: OCSF API Activity events the identity-compromise playbook reads during the lateral-movement hunt: cloud control-plane calls (STS / AssumeRole chains, cross-tenant access), SaaS API token reuse, and OAuth-grant escalation attributable to the compromised principal within the configured lookback window.
